name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: perl:5.26
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: cpanm --notest --installdeps .
      - run: perl Makefile.PL
      - run: make
      - run: prove -lv t
